source_description: Historical production public-schema snapshot captured before the Wave 0 booking/security migrations, with the recursive price-history view corrected from its base-table contract; contains no table data or credentials. The excluded migration only removes production ledger backup rows that are not contained in this snapshot; its irreversible production guard remains validated by its release contract. The assertion-only migration preserves its function replacement while omitting its production-date assertions, which require historical calendar data absent from this schema-only baseline. Statement omissions remove production-data seed inserts (pinned by sha256) that need the production property or owner rows; in a row-less baseline their effect equals the properties-exists guard later migrations use, because the seed would insert nothing.
